title: The Broken Bridge
story_text:
While walking home, Leo saw that a small bridge was broken.
He needed to cross the stream to get home.
He looked around and found a longer path.
It took more time, but it was safe.
Leo chose the safer way and reached home.

title: The Quiet Answer
story_text:
In class, Mia knew the answer to a question.
But she felt shy and did not raise her hand.
Another student answered instead.
After class, Mia told the teacher she knew it.
The teacher encouraged her to try next time.

title: The Lost Wallet
story_text:
Sam found a wallet on the ground.
It had money and an ID inside.
He thought about keeping it.
But he remembered it was not his.
He returned it to the owner, who thanked him warmly.

title: The Late Project
story_text:
Anna had many days to finish her project.
She kept delaying her work.
The night before, she rushed to finish it.
Her work was not her best.
She learned to manage her time better.

title: The Brave Choice
story_text:
During a game, Tom saw a teammate fall.
Others kept playing, but Tom stopped.
He helped his teammate stand up.
They lost the game, but his friend smiled.
Tom knew he made the right choice.

title: The Empty Seat
story_text:
A new student sat alone at lunch.
Many students saw him but walked away.
Lena decided to sit beside him.
They talked and shared stories.
Soon, he was no longer alone.

title: The Hard Puzzle
story_text:
Jake tried to solve a puzzle.
At first, he could not find the right pieces.
He felt like giving up.
But he kept trying and stayed patient.
At last, he completed the puzzle and smiled.

title: The Careless Spill
story_text:
While carrying juice, Mia was not careful.
She spilled it on the floor.
She felt embarrassed and wanted to leave.
Instead, she cleaned it up herself.
Her teacher appreciated her responsibility.

title: The Missed Chance
story_text:
Noah was invited to join a school play.
He said no because he felt unsure.
Later, he saw others enjoying the stage.
He wished he had tried.
Next time, he decided to be brave.

title: The Kind Act
story_text:
During recess, a boy dropped his lunch.
Some students laughed at him.
Ella picked up the food and gave him hers.
The boy smiled and thanked her.
Her kindness made a big difference.

title: The Quiet Practice
story_text:
Ben wanted to improve in drawing.
He practiced every day in his room.
No one saw his effort at first.
After weeks, his drawings improved greatly.
His teacher praised his hard work.

title: The Heavy Bag
story_text:
Chris carried a heavy bag to school.
He struggled to walk quickly.
A classmate noticed and helped him.
Together, they reached class on time.
Chris thanked his friend for helping.

title: The Careful Plan
story_text:
A group planned a class activity.
At first, they argued about ideas.
Then they listened to each other.
They chose the best plan together.
Their activity was a success.

title: The Unexpected Rain
story_text:
During a trip, dark clouds appeared suddenly.
Rain started pouring heavily.
The group found shelter under a small hut.
They waited until the rain stopped.
They continued their trip safely.

title: The Honest Choice
story_text:
During a test, Alex saw the answers of his seatmate.
He thought about copying them.
But he knew it was wrong.
He answered on his own instead.
He felt proud of his honesty.
